test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the option that contains the error. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

With reference of your letter, the organisation wishes to hire you for the security services.

options.text: the organisation wishes to hire you

solution:
The correct answer is **'With reference of your letter'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'With reference to your letter'** should be used instead of **'With reference of your letter'.**
 
• The preposition **"of"** is not typically used in English after **"reference"** in this context. Instead, the more commonly accepted and grammatically appropriate phrase would be **"With reference to your letter."**
 
• The corrected version uses **"to"** after **"reference,"** aligning with standard English usage. This construction indicates that the organization is considering or acknowledging the contents or information provided in the letter as the basis for their decision to hire for security services.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***With reference to your letter**, the organisation wishes to hire you for the security services.*
